effects.desc:
When an enemy target with "Steadfast Safeguard" is inflicted with Weakness Break, dispels control states from all allies, action advances, and grants Aha an extra turn (this turn will count as 10 fixed Punchline points).
Increases Ultimate DMG dealt to all enemies by 25% and Elation DMG by 10%.

options.name: Comic Relief
options.desc: After an ally target uses an attack that deals Elation DMG, inflicts Vulnerability on the target receiving Elation DMG, increasing the DMG they take by 15% for 2 turn(s). This effect can trigger up to 1 time per enemy target per attack.

options.name: Exploit Opening

options.name: Land of Fertility
options.desc: Increases Skill and Ultimate DMG dealt by all allies by 30%, and additionally increases Skill and Ultimate DMG dealt by the 1st character in the lineup by 30%.

options.desc: DMG dealt by memosprites ignores 20% of the target's DEF.

options.name: Unto Apotheosis
options.desc: When ally targets consume Skill Points, increases their CRIT DMG by 6%, stacking up to 10 times.

effects.name: Memory Turbulence
effects.desc:
The character in position 1 of the ally lineup gains the Elation Skill "Euphoric Maelstrom," dealing 100% Elation DMG of the character's Type to all enemies.
At the start of each cycle, Aha immediately gains 1 extra turn, taking into account a fixed 20 Punchlines. This turn does not consume Punchlines.

effects.name: Debuff Application
effects.desc: When an ally target inflicts a debuff on an enemy target, allies additionally accumulate 1 Grit Value. This effect can be triggered up to 10 time(s) per enemy target.

effects.name: Concordant Truce
effects.desc: Decreases enemy targets' Effect RES by 30%. Increases DMG taken by enemy targets afflicted with 4 or more debuffs by 20%.

effects.name: Surging Grit
effects.desc: Upon entering "Surging Grit," deals a set amount of DMG to enemy targets 1 time for every debuff they are inflicted with. During "Surging Grit," DMG received by enemy targets increases by 50%. After each time an enemy target is inflicted with a debuff, inflicts 1 stack of "Dejection" on them, decreasing their All-Type RES by 1% for 2 turn(s). This effect can stack up to 20 time(s).

options.name: Toccata
options.desc:
Increases Ultimate and Follow-Up ATK DMG dealt by ally targets by 40%. During "Surging Grit," each time an enemy target is inflicted with the "Dejection" effect, it changes to stacking 2 stack(s) of this effect instead. The max stacking limit of the "Dejection" effect increases to 5 stacks.
Every enemy target hit with ally targets' Ultimate or Follow-Up ATK additionally accumulates 1 Grit Value for allies.

options.name: Mirthful Cadence
options.desc:
After an ally character uses an Elation Skill to attack an enemy target, inflicts the "Indulgence" effect on the attacked enemy target, increasing the DMG taken by this target by 15% for 2 turn(s). This effect applied by each character exists independently. Upon entering "Surging Grit", allies gain 40 Punchline(s).
After ally targets use Basic ATK or Skill, for each enemy target hit, additionally accumulates 3 Grit Value for allies.

options.name: Fugato
options.desc:
During "Surging Grit," after an ally target uses an attack, additionally causes 1 random DoT debuff currently applied to the attacked target to immediately produce DMG equal to 400% of its original DMG.
After every instance of DoT dealt by ally targets, additionally accumulates 1 Grit Value for allies.

effects.name: Ley Line Disturbance
effects.desc:
A powerful opponent has re-emerged from the Ley Lines, and the battle is sure to be very difficult
Affected by the Ley Line Disturbance, characters cannot be deployed multiple times
You have reached the final defensive line of the Domain. The level of disturbance here is at its highest, interfering with even the Exalted Ones and rendering their Eminent Boons ineffective. After completing the current challenge in Single-Player Mode, characters in your party will be granted Eminence or Enduring Eminence based on your performance.
During the Disturbance Outbreak, you can complete battles to claim special rewards

parts.label: Battlefield 1 · Gale Hewing
parts.note: Advantage: Stellar Glimmer characters or Anemo characters

traits.name: Big-Mouthed Jack Frost
traits.desc:
When battle begins, the Nemesis will harness Anemo energy to create a Prime Ice sculpture. After a short delay, the sculpture will transform into a Big-Mouthed Jack Frost that continuously launches snowballs.
Inflict Radiance: Stellar Glimmer on the Nemesis while it is creating the sculpture to interrupt the process and turn the ice sculpture into a harmless animal statue instead.

traits.name: Creative Frenzy
traits.desc:
Due to the effects of the Ley Line disturbance, the Nemesis will start the battle with greatly increased All Elemental RES and Physical RES and will create Prime Ice sculptures more frequently.
After an ice sculpture is transformed into a small animal statue, it will explode following a brief delay, dealing damage to the Nemesis and reducing its All Elemental RES and Physical RES, while further reducing its Anemo RES. This effect can stack up to 3 times.

traits.name: Preemptive Sweeper Mode
traits.desc:
Will immediately enter Sweeper Mode when combat starts: All Elemental and Physical RES is greatly increased, and it will generate Flow Momentum while performing attacks. The higher its Flow Momentum, the faster it will rotate and the more DMG it will deal.
It will lose Flow Momentum after taking Cryo DMG. Below a certain Flow Momentum value, it will stop rotating and attacking, and its All Elemental and Physical RES will be greatly decreased, with its Cryo RES decreasing still more.
Each time it enters Sweeper Mode, it will produce additional Elemental Orbs the first time its rotating attacks are stopped.

traits.name: Forced Counterstrike Mode
traits.desc:
If an active character enters and maintains the Nightsoul's Blessing state for a time, this opponent will enter Forced Counterstrike Mode and switch to attacking with powerful tracking rays. At this time, its All Elemental and Physical RES will be decreased.
In this state, after it takes a certain number of Cryo DMG instances, it will cease attacking altogether and its All Elemental and Physical RES will be further decreased.

traits.name: Damage-Resistant Structure
traits.desc: Affected by the Ley Line disturbance, this great foe has its All RES further increased, and it loses less Flow Momentum when struck by Cryo DMG. It will also lose less RES when in Forced Counterstrike Mode.

parts.label: Battlefield 3 · Endless Reverberation
parts.note: Advantage: Stellar Glimmer characters or Pyro characters

traits.name: Ice Coffin: Twinned Crystal Lattice
traits.desc:
During battle, when the Nemesis's HP falls below a certain threshold, it will encase itself in an Ice Coffin and gain a Cryo Ward to protect itself.
While the Ice Coffin is active, the Nemesis will continuously unleash icy storms around itself. If the Ice Coffin is not destroyed, the Nemesis restores a portion of its HP and creates ice swords to launch a counterattack. However, if the Ice Coffin sustaining its life is destroyed, it enters a weakened state for a period of time and takes backlash DMG. Due to the Ley Line disturbance, the Ice Coffin will be more durable. A short time after it is destroyed for the first time, the Nemesis will encase itself in another Ice Coffin.

traits.name: Ice Coffin: Warped Crystal Lattice
traits.desc: While the Ice Coffin is active, if the Nemesis is affected by Radiance: Stellar Glimmer, the Ice Coffin's Cryo Ward will transform into a shield that absorbs DMG. Once the shield is destroyed, the Nemesis will take a large amount of backlash DMG.

effects.name: Frontier buff 1
effects.desc: Agent Sharp DMG increases by 20%. After defeating normal enemies, Agents with the Stun specialty restore 15 Energy.

effects.name: Frontier buff 2
effects.desc: When Agents' Basic Attack, Special Attack, and Ultimate hit enemies, PEN Ratio increases by 10%. If the enemy is Stunned, ignore 15% of their Electric RES.

traits.desc: Agent Sharp DMG increases by 20%. After defeating normal enemies, Agents with the Stun specialty restore 15 Energy.
When Agents' Basic Attack, Special Attack, and Ultimate hit enemies, PEN Ratio increases by 10%. If the enemy is Stunned, ignore 15% of their Electric RES.

If there are 2/3 Agents with the Anomaly specialty in the squad, Attribute Anomaly DMG dealt by Agents increases by 10%/60%, and the whole squad initially gains 500/1,500 Decibels upon entering combat.
Agent Fire DMG and Ether DMG increase by 15%, and Sheer DMG increases by 15%.
Agent Ultimate DMG increases by 30%. When an Ultimate attack hits an enemy, it ignores 10% of the target's All-Attribute RES.
